text:
erin: heads-up — reshard + schema tweak for accounts.meta (add `region_affinity` enum) tonight. target quiesce 2026-03-27T04:00Z. requesting lock window 03:55-04:10 to allow shard moves and safety checks.

kevin: ack. plan to do tenant-by-tenant canary: tenant-42 04:00-04:03, then fast roll remaining small-tenants 04:04-04:08, finally large-tenant cohort 04:09-04:10 if metrics look good.

erin: we'll run the resharding tool with dry-run first, then live. consumer pin: app=2.5.0-reshard-20260327 for 48h.

deploy-bot: SCHEDULED: accounts.meta.reshard_v1 -> 2026-03-27T04:00:00Z
 - version_pin: app=2.5.0-reshard-20260327
 - canary: tenant-42 04:00-04:03
 - rollout windows: 04:04-04:08 small-tenants, 04:09-04:10 large-cohort (fast gates)
 - preflight: checksum + dry-run OK required
 - abort: `deploybot abort 1879994321`

ops-bot: BACKUP: snapshot accounts-meta pre-migration at 03:30 UTC (snap-187999-0330).

luis: preflight notes: dry-run flagged 2 hot keys (tenant=bigcorp, shard-9). plan: special paged move for those keys and reduced concurrency (concurrency=8). also KV lock can balloon if we do naive reassign.

kevin: abort criteria suggestion: any of these ->
 - replication lag > 500ms sustained for 60s on >1 replica
 - db.lock_wait_p95 > 4s for 2+ nodes
 - any primary failover OR svc error rate >1% for 3min
If triggered, run `deploybot abort 1879994321` and unpin consumers. Escape hatch: `kubectl annotate deploy svc-accounts rollback=true && kubectl -n prod rollout undo deploy/svc-accounts`

erin: add operational step: after canary, wait 3min steady-state observing p99 and lockwait before continuing. If any hotkey surgery required, pause and run manual paged transfer.

devrel: i'll update release notes: "accounts.meta: add region_affinity enum; resharding for multi-region affinity. Consumers pinned to 2.5.0 for 48h." Also prepping a short customer note in case we need to communicate transient latency.

ops-bot: RUNBOOK CHECKLIST:
```
 - snapshot taken: yes
 - dry-run pass: yes
 - migration binary sha256: abc123... (matches)
 - canary shard set: tenant-42
 - monitoring dashboards: accounts-meta-reshard pinned
 - rollback hook: enabled
```
To abort: `deploybot abort 1879994321`

luis: logging watchpoints: db.query_p99, db.lock_wait_p95, repl.lag_ms, svc_account_errors, resharder.progress. set alert thresholds on dashboards.

kevin: i'm oncall for this window and will watch lockwatch + replication. i'll post a pre-start in #prod-alerts 10m before.

erin: final note: gate schema activation behind feature-flag `accounts_meta_region_affinity` — flip only after reshard progress shows <60s lag for 10m. we'll unpin consumers after 48h or sooner if stable.

kevin: sounds good. see you in the window.
